question: 从Wikidata SPARQL查询中提取50个高频三元组（Subject-Predicate-Object），需过滤掉在Wikipedia语料库中出现频率低于100次的实体，以确保Qwen3.8-27B训练数据中大概率包含该事实，消除训练数据缺失导致的假阳性幻觉。

sources.title: Wikidata:SPARQL tutorial - Wikidata
sources.snippet: WDQS, the Wikidata Query Service, is a powerful tool to provide insight into Wikidata's content. This guide will teach you how to use it. See also the interactive tutorial by Wikimedia Israel. Before writing your own SPARQL query, look at { {Item documentation}} or any other generic SPARQL query template and see if your query is already included.
